    For more than 25 years, Eagle Point Funding has been helping dual-use startups cross “The Innovation Valley of Death” through strategic support in soft money, investments, and initial sales.

    ​

    We specialize in maximizing non-dilutive funding by:
    • Identifying multiple opportunities for R&D and commercialization
    • Crafting competitive proposals for federal and state programs
    • Navigating applications across a wide range of agencies
    • Supporting all related LoIs, MoUs, and matching fund requirements

    ​

    Our B2G arm, Deep-Tech Showcase, connects founders with the right people in the right places - across government agencies, corporations, and investment firms.

    ​

    Meanwhile, Deep-Tech Marketing, our B2B division, helps dual-use startups accelerate growth - from strategy and product–market fit to marketing materials, campaigns, and full-scale sales operations and lead generation.
     

    About Eagle Point Funding

    Your Opportunities

    SBIR/STTR Grants

    Small Business Research and Development grants typically award around $150,000 for SBIR/STTR Phase I awards and up to $2 million for SBIR/STTR Phase II awards.

    Large Scale Funding (BAAs)

    Multidisciplinary grants and contracts available for all stages of development, from proof-of-concept through commercialization, with budgets of up to $16 million per project.

    Contract Navigation & Funding Strategy

    We guide startups through government programs to secure strategic funding. Tailored plans to align your technology with the right agency calls.
